title: SPADE: Speculative Decoding for Precise and Low Cost Distributed Edge Cloud Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.13076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in natural language understanding and generation, but their deployment is constrained by high computational demands. Deploying smaller LLMs directly on the edge can circumvent this, but with degraded accuracy. Deploying smaller cloud-based big LLMs preserves performance, but at the cost of expensive per-token computation. We present a distributed inference framework, \our{}, that integrates speculative decoding (SD) across edge and cloud. A compact draft model deployed on the edge generates candidate tokens rapidly, and a large verifier model on the cloud validates these tokens in parallel. Accepted tokens are retained, while only rejections trigger verifier correction, substantially reducing the number of cloud queries. Our plug-and-play design shifts the bulk of computation to the edge, significantly lowers inference time and cloud cost, and preserves the accuracy of the big

translated_title: SPADE：面向精确且低成本的分布式边缘云推理的投机解码方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言理解和生成方面取得了显著成功，但其部署受到高计算需求的制约。直接在边缘部署较小的LLM可以规避这一问题，但会降低准确性。在云端部署较小的LLM可以保持性能，但代价是昂贵的逐token计算。我们提出了一种分布式推理框架SPADE，该框架将投机解码（SD）集成到边缘和云端。部署在边缘的紧凑草稿模型能够快速生成候选token，而云端的大型验证模型则并行验证这些token。接受的token被保留，仅拒绝触发验证模型修正，从而大幅减少云端查询次数。我们的即插即用设计将大部分计算转移到边缘，显著降低推理时间和云端成本，同时保持大型模型的准确性。
tldr: SPADE通过在边缘部署草稿模型、云端部署验证模型的投机解码机制，实现了在保持大模型准确性的同时大幅降低推理延迟和云端成本。
en_tdlr: SPADE integrates speculative decoding across edge and cloud by deploying a draft model on the edge and a verifier model in the cloud, significantly reducing inference latency and cloud costs while maintaining the accuracy of large models.
